extraction.notes: EQR reports no AFFO, so affo fields are null. FFO subtotal taken as 'FFO available to Common Shares and Units' (345,767), which is the subtotal the bridge reaches after preferred distributions; the company's 'FFO' line before preferred distributions is 346,540, and 'Normalized FFO' is 348,559. Preferred distributions are categorized 'other' because they are a bridge item, not an FFO adjustment. 'Non-operating asset (gains) losses' (312) is categorized 'other' because the nature of the asset is not specified. Impairment – non-operating assets and the unconsolidated operating-asset sale gain are zero/'—' in the quarter and are included at 0. Recurring capex: the only capex table is six-month, not quarterly, and no AFFO section exists, so null. Diluted shares 389,363 (thousands) reproduces FFO per share 0.89 and Normalized FFO per share 0.89.
